about: Road alignment design-check references. Stopping sight distance closed form (sources W3, W4; >= 2 sources agree, grade A) and the TxDOT Table 4-23 rows that reproduce the AASHTO Green Book basis; minimum radius row from TxDOT Table 4-7 (single extract, grade B). The AASHTO Green Book itself is paywalled and was not read. llull's alignment checks are metric (km/h, m): US rows are converted exactly (1 mph = 1.609344 km/h, 1 ft = 0.3048 m) and compared to the formula in its metric form only where the metric constants are the formula's own (0.278, 0.039, a = 3.4 m/s2).

cases.what: SSD on level grade, US customary, TxDOT Table 4-23 rows
cases.tolerance: calculated SSD within 0.1 ft of published; design SSD = calculated rounded up to the next 5 ft, exact

cases.what: SSD metric closed form at the speeds llull's SPEED_TABLE uses
cases.note: the Green Book metric design values (rounded) were not read; only the closed form gates

cases.what: Minimum radius at e_max = 8 %, 50 mph (TxDOT Table 4-7 e = 8.0 row)
cases.note: f(50 mph) = 0.14 is NOT confirmed from a fetched source; the case is non-gating until f is sourced (owner question 2)
cases.tolerance: rounded to the table's 3 significant figures

cases.what: Minimum clothoid length by rate of change of lateral acceleration (Barnett / Shortt form), C = 0.6 m/s3 as in llull roadChecks.ts:17
cases.llull: Ls = V^3 / (46.656 C R), V km/h, R and Ls m, C = 0.6 m/s3 (packages/domain-aec/src/civil/road/roadChecks.ts:1-6, :17); 46.656 = 3.6^3
cases.note: no fetched public source states this criterion with its constant AND a worked example; TBD - locate a free state-DOT or FHWA example before gating. Also unsourced: SPEED_TABLE side friction f and minimum crest / sag K (roadChecks.ts:21-24)
